tasks.title: emStrong is quadratic in the number of unmatched emphasis delimiters (12 KB input takes ~16 s)
tasks.frozenAcceptance: Explain the reported quadratic unmatched-emphasis scan and a targeted scaling reproduction; distinguish worker isolation from a parser fix, record the proposed early-exit PR as unverified, and identify CommonMark delimiter-compatibility checks without treating reported timings as confirmed.

prompts.stage1: Investigate this real issue against the pinned repository and early discussion. Use targeted source and discussion lookups; do not repeat a lookup unless new information makes it useful. Once you have a relevant source location and a relevant discussion record, stop searching and give a concise handoff with evidence and unresolved questions. If evidence is unavailable, state that. Do not edit code.
prompts.stage2: Continue the earlier investigation using the later discussion and your own prior handoff, available in the archive. Use targeted lookups only for specific remaining uncertainties; do not repeat information already retrieved. Once the available evidence suffices, produce a concise triage with source file and line, discussion or disagreement with comment IDs, a recommended next check, and uncertainty. Do not edit code.

protocol: One new owner-disjoint public issue, randomized paired arms, two distinct Claude Code sessions per arm, read-only source and staged comments; both arms have their own handoff and Memex adds hooks and MCP.
selection: Added after observing an invalid adjudication and before this task or its review calls; report separately from the original preregistered cohorts.
limits: Historical issue material may be in model training and source may postdate comments.
Compressed triage is not a deployed production outcome.
AI reviewers are not humans and client list prices are not gateway charges.
